title: 💥 Zeteo’s Biggest News Yet! Zeteo UK Is HERE!
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
I can't quite remember the _exact_ moment when I realized we needed a
**Zeteo** specifically for the UK.

Was it after watching the Gorton and Denton by-election in late February, when
almost every major media outlet from [Sky
News](https://x.com/SamCoatesSky/status/2027142762261348696?lang=en) to the
[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5yqpr28jrwo) to the _[Daily
Mail](https://www.dailymail.com/news/article-15600165/Police-probe-family-
voting-fraud-sectarian-Gorton-Denton-election-Farage-poll-alarm.html) _helped
spread Reform UK's [lie](https://www.gmp.police.uk/news/greater-
manchester/news/news/2026/march/criminal-investigation-concludes-into-family-
voting-
allegations/?__cf_chl_rt_tk=NpXHpXVy3BD8eIslW27a9j6AT8m7UfpXJusbfuOxXn4-1780801205-1.0.1.1-A.LW5Hz_kjV2OorLtmCWAMnYBe7DYh8E64Lfa1i_p0c)
about British Muslims engaging in illegal 'family voting' for the Greens?

Was it after [examining the egregious
failure](https://www.declassifieduk.org/they-attack-we-defend-how-the-media-
toes-the-line-on-iran/) of mainstream media in the UK in the first week of
March to describe the joint U.S.-Israeli attack on Iran as illegal, a
violation of the UN Charter, and a clear act of aggression?

Was it after reading a [linguistic analysis](https://newscord.org/uk-analysis)
by UK media bias comparison app NewsCord in late April, which showed how some
of the UK's leading news organizations ["failed to name Israel as the
perpetrator in Israeli attacks where civilians were killed in
Gaza"](https://novaramedia.com/2026/04/23/bbc-failed-to-name-israel-as-
perpetrator-in-half-of-civilian-casualty-reports-data-shows/) in around half
of _all_ cases?

Was it after witnessing the British [media pile-
on](https://theweek.com/politics/green-party-zack-polanski-antisemitism)
against Green Party leader Zack Polanski in early May, over the issue of
antisemitism, while most journalists gave Reform UK leader Nigel Farage a
[pass](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2026/may/14/free-pass-
antisemitism-left-right-nigel-farage-zack-polanski-jewish) on that same issue?

Or perhaps… it was _all of the above_.

[SUBSCRIBE TO ZETEO UK TODAY](https://zeteonews.co.uk/subscribe)

The UK media is broken. TV ratings are in decline, newspaper circulations have
been collapsing for years, and trust in journalism is disappearing fast.
Britain ranks [32nd out of
48](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-
report/2025/united-kingdom) countries for trust in news, placing it in the
bottom third of the countries surveyed, and far below the levels seen in other
major European democracies. The only professions in the UK that command [less
public trust](https://www.ipsos.com/en-uk/ipsos-veracity-index-2025) than
journalists are advertising executives and politicians.

I have to say that I take no pleasure in the crisis engulfing the British
media. I spent a decade inside the mainstream media, working for the BBC, ITV,
Channel 4, and Sky News. Those were the years that shaped me as a journalist.
I worked alongside many remarkable colleagues and came away convinced that a
strong and healthy democracy depends on a strong and healthy media.

For far too long, however, mainstream media in the UK has failed the public.
It has downplayed the rise of the far right at home while helping manufacture
consent for genocide abroad. It has claimed the mantle of fearless truth-
telling while too often bending to the wishes of the powerful. It has stressed
independence and impartiality while too often bowing to corporate interests -
or, in the case of the BBC, to political pressures from the government of the
day.

The good news is that there is another way. In the United States, independent
journalism has [exploded](https://www.theguardian.com/us-
news/2026/jan/09/independent-journalism-resistance-trump), reaching
[millions](https://www.newsweek.com/how-substack-became-hottest-social-media-
platform-11702877) of people who no longer defer to establishment media
gatekeepers. [Polls](https://changeresearch.com/americans-turn-to-independent-
voices-as-traditional-media-loses-ground/) show Americans increasingly placing
more trust in independent and online journalists than in traditional national
news organizations.

[SUBSCRIBE TO ZETEO UK TODAY](https://zeteonews.co.uk/subscribe)

There is no reason Britain cannot follow America's lead (at least in this one
positive trend!). No reason we cannot build a media landscape that is more
fearless, more accountable, and more willing to speak truth to power.

We, **Zeteo** , have had huge success in the United States as an independent
outlet - breaking big [news](https://zeteo.com/p/breaking-dhs-detains-
palestinian) [stories](https://zeteo.com/p/zeteo-documentary-exposes-shireen-
abu-akleh-israeli-soldier-shooter-name) and producing [ground-
breaking](https://zeteo.com/s/who-killed-shireen)
[documentaries](https://zeteo.com/s/reelisrael); winning
[multiple](https://x.com/zeteo_news/status/1851301888991670633)
[awards](https://x.com/zeteo_news/status/2046645265344364674); and acquiring
[hundreds of thousands](http://zeteo.com/subscribe) of loyal subscribers on
Substack and _[millions](http://zeteo.com/subscribe)_ on YouTube. All this has
been possible thanks to the financial support of all our _paid_ subscribers.
Every paid subscription helps us expand and fund real journalism.

Now, we want to replicate that growth and success in the UK. **Zeteo UK** will
produce exclusive UK content by UK reporters for its subscribers. We'll be
bringing together some of the smartest British media voices from across the
political spectrum - including **Sangita Myska, Owen Jones, Grace Blakeley,
Afua Hirsch,** and**Peter Oborne** \- while our daily coverage of Westminster
politics will be helmed by former ITV News reporter and presenter **Shehab
Khan** , who has interviewed the past six British prime ministers.

Oh, and I'll be involved too! I plan to join many of **Zeteo UK 's** live
events, both online and in person, as well as co-host shows and write op-eds.
(I caught the UK politics bug at a very young age and - despite Donald Trump's
antics now commanding much of my journalistic time and attention - I haven't
lost it yet!)

So why would you _not_ **[subscribe](https://zeteonews.co.uk/subscribe)** to
it?

To be clear, this is a soft __ launch. We'll spend the coming months expanding
our reporting, growing our team, and building something worthy of this
historic political moment in the UK. We'll be publishing videos and articles
on a _semi-regular_ basis, some of which will be paywalled. Then, in
September, we launch officially with daily content, including op-eds, news
shows, and video podcasts - and we're also planning a big live event in London
with a very prominent British politician!

But every launch has a beginning.

Tomorrow, with your help and support, a new force for journalism, truth-
telling, and disruption arrives in the UK media landscape.

Today, **Zeteo UK** is born.
